name: Huayna Capac's northern wars
summary: The eleventh Sapa Inca spends most of his reign in the far north, where the Cayambe and Caranqui resist for well over a decade. He builds a second capital at Tumebamba, rings the north with hilltop forts, and ends the war in a massacre the chroniclers remember at Yahuarcocha, the 'lake of blood'. He dies at Quito of an epidemic, probably smallpox, that runs ahead of the Spaniards.

stops.note: His birthplace becomes a second capital.
The base for the war in the north.
The Caranqui are defeated on the lakeshore.
